trees.why: Moving a split and watching Gini change builds intuition fast; depth, pruning and forests then need clear explanation.

boosting.why: The residual loop and tuning order are learned by reading, then by training and explaining a real model end to end.

knnsvm.why: Adding points and changing k shows how neighbours vote; margins, kernels and Naive Bayes need worked explanation.

clustering.why: Stepping k-means by hand makes the loop obvious, and a segmentation project teaches scaling, choosing k and profiling.
